monotonicity_verification.authority: official Microsoft Research copy of the ICDE paper
monotonicity_verification.location: Section 4.1, cost-monotonicity assumption for SPJ selectivity variables
monotonicity_verification.scope_guardrail: The manuscript distinguishes optimizer cost over selectivity variables from PostgreSQL q-error under extended-statistics set inclusion.

contribution_3_change_reason: The Introduction now calls CE-Replay a validated objective oracle and ties incremental equality to audited full-replay move values within the supported setting, avoiding two adjacent uses of exact with different implicit scopes. Formal exactness statements remain where assumptions are explicit.
positive_positioning: CE-Replay represents the supported statistics-sensitive native estimator computation as executable over hypothetical statistics states and exposes objective and statistics-semantic dependency interfaces.
strongest_novelty_threat: INUM and C-PQO already demonstrate reusable, configuration-parametric representations of optimizer behavior, so generic hypothetical evaluation, response reuse, and avoidance of repeated optimizer calls cannot carry the novelty argument.
bounded_distinction: The defensible distinction is the positively documented computation layer: optimizer plan/cost behavior over physical configurations versus bounded executable statistics-sensitive estimator computation and its design-relevant state transitions.
